description: This file contains test cases for multi-configuration (multiconfig) build scenarios within a Yocto/OpenEmbedded environment. The tests verify that multiconfig build configurations are correctly parsed, trigger proper rebuilds when configurations change, and work from layers. It defines a class `MultiConfig` that includes multiple test methods for different aspects of multiconfig functionality.

classes.name: MultiConfig
classes.description: A test case class for verifying multiconfig build scenarios in Yocto/OpenEmbedded.

methods.name: test_multiconfig(self)
methods.description: Tests that a simple multiconfig build works using specific images and configurations.

methods.name: test_multiconfig_reparse(self)
methods.description: Checks that changes to multiconfig configuration files trigger correct reparse and rebuilds, verifying variable values after modifications.

methods.name: test_multiconfig_inlayer(self)
methods.description: Verifies that multiconfig from a layer (meta-selftest) functions correctly, primarily by performing a dry run to check configuration presence.
